title: Jatland Wiki: Dhatarwal (gotra page; villages founded by Nathu Dhatarwal's family; Nathu Dada devli at Khiyana)
what_it_contains: Community-wiki genealogy: Nathu Dhatarwal (b. VS 1380, d. Asoj badi 9 VS 1444) and relatives founded 12 villages: Kheenyera, Soolera, Bheekhnera, Kumbhana, Kolana, Ajeetmana, Ladera, Bhanabasti, Meghana, Manera, Thoiya, Nathor (Nathuwas); Chudana and Mulera also named. Section on Nathu Dada devli near Khiyana inside MFFR: temple by Dhatarwal community, annual fair on Asoj navami, Army provides water and order and cleans the temple on Tuesdays, release of Devdas Rankawat's biography.
why_relevant: Founding traditions for 9 of the project villages; confirms Nathor = Nathuwas as a name; separates Kolana from Chudana.
found_via: screenshots sent by TechnoTaau Team (site blocked from this machine)
